Reverie: bicameral memory for AI-assisted development. Product reframe of codexCLI, locked 2026-05-06 (deep rebrand shipped v1.0.0-beta.1, docs/design-rebrand-deep.md).

THESIS: entries function as Westworld reveries — the agent reads at session start, hears the project's other voice from prior sessions' deposits, achieves conscious context. Positioning: "Bootstrapping GenAI consciousness for your projects." Name origin: the Westworld subroutines that gave hosts consciousness via fragments of prior-loop memories; chosen by user 2026-05-06.

BRAND: parent SeaBear Studios; canonical URL seabear.dev/reverie; binary rvr; repo seabearDEV/reverie (renamed, not forked); npm @seabear/reverie (scoped — bare rvr taken); tap seabearDEV/homebrew-reverie.

NAMING CONVENTION: full brand pull-through on EVERY surface (.reverie/ dir, $reverie envelope with indefinite $codexcli read back-compat, RVR_* env vars, reverie_* MCP tools, "Reverie" as system name). The earlier Phase-3 codex_* carve-out was REVERSED 2026-05-06 — don't reintroduce split branding.

CLEARANCE (2026-05-06, decision: proceed, no premium domain, no own-mark filing): reverie.{dev,ai,io} all taken — .ai/.io are make-offer parks, .dev is a low-prominence Sitecore agency (the closest live risk: common-law Class-42 mark, but different segment). USPTO: zero "REVERIE" marks in dev tools/AI; nearest is JTMD's registered IC-009 smart-mattress app. If filing is ever pursued, house-mark format ("REVERIE by SeaBear") clears easiest. .reverie/ dotfile dir uncontested. Source: ~/Downloads/tmSearchResults2026-05-06.xlsx; full DuPont analysis in git history of this entry.

AUDIENCES (priority): 1) AI agents via MCP, 2) humans via CLI, 3) web visualization (roadmap v1.1+).
